destination.title: Engineering axion ranges and couplings
destination.question: Which mechanisms enlarge or reorganize axion field ranges and couplings, and when do those scales support the intended inflationary or relaxion application?
destination.summary: Compare alignment, kinetic and Stückelberg mixing, winding, branches, clockwork and hierarchy generation while retaining their different physical scales.

regimes: Source-specific small input scales and enhanced effective scales
assumptions: Range enhancement alone does not establish an inflationary solution or ultraviolet control.
conventions: Coupling suppression, periodicity, domain diameter and trajectory length are not interchangeable.
excludes: A common fine identity for all enhancement mechanisms

sources.title: A Natural Framework for Chaotic Inflation

evidence.text: Can axion–4-form mixing produce a radiatively stable quadratic inflaton potential over a super-Planckian field range without requiring a super-Planckian axion decay constant?

sources.title: Natural inflation with multiple sub-Planckian axions

evidence.text: Can KNP alignment with N > 2 sub-Planckian axions generate a super-Planckian effective decay constant using order-one integer coefficients, and what alignment probability and explicit winding structures realize that enhancement?

sources.title: Chaotic inflation with kinetic alignment of axion fields

evidence.text: Can kinetic mixing among N sub-Planckian axions produce a collective displacement exceeding their Pythagorean range, and under what conditions can inflation follow that enlarged direction?

sources.title: Notes on natural inflation

evidence.text: Can strong gauge dynamics generate an axion inflation potential with sufficiently long metastable branches, allowing large-field inflation with a fundamental decay constant at or below the reduced Planck scale? How much of the large-N argument can be made explicit at finite N?

sources.title: Natural Inflation with Natural Trans-Planckian Axion Decay Constant from Anomalous $U(1)_X$

evidence.text: Can gauging an axion shift under anomalous U(1)X stabilize the real modulus independently of its axion, while generating a natural-inflation potential with an effective trans-Planckian decay constant?

sources.title: Natural Inflation from Near Alignment in Heterotic String Theory

evidence.text: Can near alignment of two heterotic Kähler axions generate a super-Planckian effective decay constant for natural inflation while their fundamental decay constants remain sub-Planckian?

sources.title: Planckian Axions in String Theory

evidence.text: Can many axions have a super-Planckian fundamental-domain diameter despite small eigenvalues of their original kinetic metric, and under what conditions can this geometric range support inflation?

sources.title: Inflation by Alignment

evidence.text: How are kinetic and lattice alignment related in two-field inflation, and can the same mechanisms extend from compact axions to noncompact pseudo-Goldstone potentials, enhancing tensors or generating slow-roll?

sources.title: Large Field Inflation from Axion Mixing

evidence.text: Can kinetic and Stückelberg mixing produce an effectively super-Planckian axion decay constant from intrinsically sub-Planckian periodicities, without monodromy, decay-constant alignment or a large field multiplicity, while preserving gauge consistency?

sources.title: Realizing the relaxion from multiple axions and its UV completion with high scale supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can the enormous field excursion required by the relaxion mechanism arise from compact, sub-Planckian periodic axions, with an explicit completion that also generates the scanning Higgs mass and stopping potential?

sources.title: Large field excursions and approximate discrete symmetries from a clockwork axion

evidence.text: Can a renormalizable theory with scalar expectation values f<MPl produce a compact pseudo-Goldstone field range 2πF with F≫f, and how many fields are needed? Inflation and relaxion excursions motivate the question.

sources.title: Large field excursions from a few site relaxion model

evidence.text: Can a non-abelian few-site model generate the large, compact field range needed for relaxation using periodic operators, while admitting a warped extra-dimensional interpretation and electroweak stopping?

sources.title: Backreaction in Axion Monodromy, 4-forms and the Swampland

evidence.text: A periodic axion can support a non-periodic inflationary potential by following a branch of a larger discrete-symmetric system. This permits a winding range exceeding the fundamental axion period without establishing its controlled proper length.

sources.title: Clockwork Axions in Cosmology: Is Chromonatural Inflation Chrononatural?

evidence.text: Can the large axion-gauge couplings required by cosmological models be generated from smaller UV input integers through alignment or clockwork, especially for chromonatural inflation with a sub-Planckian effective axion range?

sources.title: Enhancement of the Axion Decay Constant in Inflation and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can axion inflation satisfy the assumed microscopic bound f < M_Pl while having an effective decay constant above M_Pl, through coherent harmonic cancellation or through noncanonical DBI dynamics?

sources.title: Super-Planckian axions from near-conformality

evidence.text: Can nearly conformal sectors generate exponentially hierarchical axion decay constants and trans-Planckian effective field ranges without tuned charges or many axion fields, with a calculable warped-space description?

sources.title: Axion scales and couplings with Stückelberg mixing

evidence.text: How does Stückelberg mixing determine the surviving axion's periodic field range and physical couplings, especially when a suppressed coefficient of ξGG̃ has been interpreted as an enhanced decay constant?

sources.title: Hierarchical Axiverse

evidence.text: Can low-energy axion mixing organize mass and decay-constant hierarchies beyond UV input alone, while remaining compatible with axion Swampland bounds?

sources.title: Hierarchical Axion Inflation

evidence.text: Can two axions with sub-Planckian fundamental decay constants generate a super-Planckian effective decay constant through a simple hierarchy, using only nonperturbative potentials and avoiding a tuned alignment?

sources.title: A Natural Framework for Chaotic Inflation

evidence.text: A first-order formulation introduces q as a Lagrange multiplier enforcing F=dA. Completing the square and integrating out F, while retaining the necessary boundary and membrane terms, gives an effective scalar potential and the local equation ∂q=0.

sources.title: Natural inflation with multiple sub-Planckian axions

evidence.text: Use cofactors of the first N − 1 coefficient rows to construct the flat direction. Its primitive closed period is fixed by the gcd of the cofactors; restoring the final cosine determines the number of modulations through the full matrix determinant.

sources.title: Chaotic inflation with kinetic alignment of axion fields

evidence.text: The authors analyze the metric geometry of the periodic domain, using eigenvalues and eigenvectors of K to convert dimensionless lattice displacements into physical lengths. Random-matrix eigenvector delocalization supplies the proposed statistical mechanism for approximate alignment.

sources.title: Hierarchical Axion Inflation

evidence.text: For possible string realizations, the authors specify toy Kähler and superpotentials, estimate stabilized moduli and nonperturbative amplitudes, and discuss the canonical normalization needed to translate microscopic choices into an effective field range.

sources.title: Notes on natural inflation

evidence.text: The reviewed large-N argument combines color counting at fixed ’t Hooft coupling with the Euclidean vacuum-energy generating functional, giving V(θ)=N²h(θ/N)+… and a fixed-angle expansion around θ/N=0.

sources.title: Natural Inflation with Natural Trans-Planckian Axion Decay Constant from Anomalous $U(1)_X$

evidence.text: Use the supergravity F-term potential eᴷ(Kⁱʲ̄DiW Dʲ̄W̄−3|W|²), minimize the dominant matter-sector terms, and estimate VEV shifts caused by the overall eᴷ factor and the small nonperturbative coupling.

sources.title: No warm inflation from a vanilla axion

evidence.text: Can sphaleron heating sustain sufficiently long, strongly dissipative slow-roll inflation while preserving the defining periodicity and coupling structure of a vanilla axion? The argument seeks an obstruction independent of observational constraints.

sources.title: Emergence of Weak Coupling at Large Distance in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can a finite super-Planckian scalar path substantially alter the states belonging to an EFT even without a tower approaching zero mass? Axions supply the motivating case because a periodic spectrum can have nearly constant state density.

sources.title: Natural inflation with and without modulations in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Can a complex-structure axion realize natural inflation with a trans-Planckian effective decay constant through one-loop gauge thresholds, while other moduli are stabilized? When do subleading threshold terms produce consequential modulations?

sources.title: Towards Natural Inflation in String Theory

evidence.text: Can two axions with sub-Planckian fundamental decay constants realize natural inflation in type IIB string theory while stabilizing the compactification and keeping inflation below the decompactification barrier?

sources.title: Dante's Inferno

evidence.text: Can two axions support high-scale, chaotic-like inflation with a superplanckian trajectory inside a region of subplanckian diameter, while suppressing an η problem and easing control constraints in a string realization?

sources.title: The String landscape, black holes and gravity as the weakest force

evidence.text: Does a large axion decay constant guarantee a flat periodic inflationary potential in quantum gravity?

sources.title: Analytic results in aligned axion inflation

evidence.text: Can metastable trajectories in minimal aligned two-axion inflation be characterized analytically, including their existence, instability endpoint and CMB phenomenology, and does their short field excursion remove the trans-Planckian kinetic-scale problem?

sources.title: Warping the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a single open-string axion in a warped compactification have a super-Planckian decay constant consistently with the Weak Gravity Conjecture, and can the resulting construction support large-field inflation with observable primordial tensors?

sources.title: Fencing in the Swampland: Quantum Gravity Constraints on Large Field Inflation

evidence.text: The paper asks whether collective axion mechanisms evade single-axion restrictions on large-field inflation. It seeks consistency tests useful when stabilization and corrections make explicit string constructions difficult to assess.

sources.title: Helical Inflation and Cosmic Strings

evidence.text: Can a two-axion helical trajectory produce a super-Planckian effective field range, and can departures from quadratic inflation or a subdominant cosmic-string B-mode component reveal the underlying axionic scenario?

sources.title: Natural Inflation and Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can natural inflation with a parametrically large effective axion range be realized in a controlled higher-dimensional effective theory while satisfying the quantum-gravity constraints represented by the paper's Weak Gravity Conjecture criterion?

sources.title: Aligned natural inflation with modulations

evidence.text: Does aligned natural inflation compatible with the multi-axion weak gravity conjecture generically acquire subleading potential modulations, and what oscillations and observational constraints follow?

sources.title: Natural and Multi-Natural Inflation in Axion Landscape

evidence.text: Can accidental alignment among many axions with sub-Planckian decay constants produce a sufficiently flat, super-Planckian inflationary direction, and connect slow-roll inflation after tunneling to the numbers of axions and symmetry-breaking sources?

sources.title: The inflated Chern-Simons number in spectator chromo-natural inflation

evidence.text: Can phenomenologically interesting spectator chromo-natural inflation generate its required large quantized axion–gauge coupling through clockwork, while retaining observational agreement and calculational control? What additional restrictions follow from perturbative unitarity and conjectural quantum-gravity conditions?

sources.title: Aligned Natural Inflation: Monodromies of two Axions

evidence.text: Can alignment of two axions provide the large effective displacement needed for natural inflation while keeping individual decay constants below the Planck scale, and how does the misalignment parameter determine the predicted scalar and tensor spectra?

sources.title: Trajectories with suppressed tensor-to-scalar ratio in Aligned Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Which inflationary trajectories occur in the general two-axion aligned potential, and can their scalar tilt, tensor amplitude or gauge-field couplings distinguish Aligned Natural Inflation from single-field Natural Inflation?

sources.title: Natural Inflation and Low Energy Supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can high-scale natural inflation coexist with low-scale or unbroken supersymmetry while addressing both effective trans-Planckian axion motion and stabilization of the saxionic partners in a string-inspired description?

sources.title: Axion Inflation in F-theory

evidence.text: Can F-theory axions support natural inflation with potentially super-Planckian decay constants while retaining control over moduli stabilization and the inflationary potential?

sources.title: Widening the Axion Window via Kinetic and Stückelberg Mixings

evidence.text: Can kinetic and Stückelberg mixing widen effective axion decay constants beyond the intrinsic scales suggested by the original Lagrangian, yielding either a super-Planckian inflationary coupling or a smaller decay constant in the conventional axion dark-matter window?

sources.title: Modulated Natural Inflation

evidence.text: Can string-motivated higher instanton harmonics preserve trans-Planckian aligned axion inflation, satisfy the mild weak gravity conjecture, and change the CMB predictions of natural inflation?

sources.title: Aligned Natural Inflation and Moduli Stabilization from Anomalous $U(1)$ Gauge Symmetries

evidence.text: Can a string-inspired supergravity model stabilize real Kähler-modulus components above the inflationary scale while retaining light axions, and realize a super-Planckian effective decay constant from sub-Planckian constituent constants?

sources.title: Towards natural inflation from weakly coupled heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Can weakly coupled heterotic compactifications realize single-field natural inflation with an effective trans-Planckian axion decay constant while stabilizing the dilaton and other moduli above the inflation scale?

sources.title: Completing natural inflation

evidence.text: Can natural inflation obtain a sufficiently flat axion potential and an effectively super-Planckian axion scale while keeping the underlying axion scales sub-Planckian?

sources.title: Constraints on Axion Inflation from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can axion decay-constant alignment yield a controlled super-Planckian inflationary displacement in type-IIB Calabi–Yau compactifications, and what restrictions follow from divisor geometry and the generalized multi-axion weak gravity conjecture?

sources.title: N-flation with Hierarchically Light Axions in String Compactifications

evidence.text: Can perturbative LVS stabilisation produce many axions hierarchically lighter than their geometric partners, allowing collective inflation or quintessence with sub-Planckian individual decay constants?

sources.title: Axion Inflation in F-theory

evidence.text: Can F-theory axions support natural inflation with potentially super-Planckian decay constants while retaining control over moduli stabilization and the inflationary potential?

sources.title: Aligned Natural Inflation and Moduli Stabilization from Anomalous $U(1)$ Gauge Symmetries

evidence.text: Can a string-inspired supergravity model stabilize real Kähler-modulus components above the inflationary scale while retaining light axions, and realize a super-Planckian effective decay constant from sub-Planckian constituent constants?

sources.title: Towards Natural Inflation in String Theory

evidence.text: Can two axions with sub-Planckian fundamental decay constants realize natural inflation in type IIB string theory while stabilizing the compactification and keeping inflation below the decompactification barrier?

sources.title: Towards natural inflation from weakly coupled heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Can weakly coupled heterotic compactifications realize single-field natural inflation with an effective trans-Planckian axion decay constant while stabilizing the dilaton and other moduli above the inflation scale?

sources.title: Natural inflation with and without modulations in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Can a complex-structure axion realize natural inflation with a trans-Planckian effective decay constant through one-loop gauge thresholds, while other moduli are stabilized? When do subleading threshold terms produce consequential modulations?

sources.title: Inflation from periodic extra dimensions

evidence.text: Can periodic extra dimensions generate the multiple sinusoidal terms needed for small-field multi-natural inflation with a sub-Planckian decay constant, within an illustrative string-inspired supersymmetry-breaking construction?

sources.title: N-flation with Hierarchically Light Axions in String Compactifications

evidence.text: Expands the N=1 F-term potential in inverse volume, combining α′ corrections, small-cycle nonperturbative effects, string loops and large-cycle nonperturbative terms. Extended no-scale cancellation makes the loop potential subleading despite its larger correction to the Kähler potential.

sources.title: Axion Inflation in F-theory

evidence.text: A local fiber/base decomposition of the three-form motivates the strong-coupling enhancement. Stabilization is discussed using Wflux=∫Y4 Ω∧G4 and nonperturbative terms with theta-function prefactors on the axion torus.

sources.title: Aligned Natural Inflation and Moduli Stabilization from Anomalous $U(1)$ Gauge Symmetries

evidence.text: First minimize the dominant matter F terms, then impose both D-flatness conditions to determine real-modulus VEVs. Subsequently retain the nonperturbative axion potential, canonically normalize its kinetic terms and rotate to heavy/light axion combinations.

sources.title: Towards Natural Inflation in String Theory

evidence.text: Hessian determinants and leading mass eigenvalues identify the flat limit and the light/heavy axion hierarchy. Integrating out the heavy mode produces the effective enhanced decay constant.

sources.title: Towards natural inflation from weakly coupled heterotic string theory

evidence.text: Applies the N=1 supergravity F-term potential, supersymmetric stabilization conditions, D-term contributions, and a gauge-singlet SUSY-breaking uplift. Heavy fields are integrated out before canonical normalization of the remaining axion; slow-roll formulas supply the illustrative observables.

sources.title: Natural inflation with and without modulations in type IIB string theory

evidence.text: Expand the eta-function to include a subleading exponential, calculate slow-roll parameters and the e-fold integral, and evaluate ns, r, and running. Higher-order terms in ns are retained when the third-derivative slow-roll combination is appreciable. The scalar amplitude is adjusted through gaugino-condensation parameters.

sources.title: Natural Chain Inflation

evidence.text: Can chain inflation be realized by an axion in supergravity, with a practical prescription for CMB observables and a viable inflation scale, while advancing toward an eventual string-theory embedding?

sources.title: Heterotic warm inflation

evidence.text: How do axion–saxion kinetic coupling, gauge-mediated dissipation and thermal backreaction determine whether heterotic-motivated inflation is warm, effectively single-field or genuinely two-field?

sources.title: Dante's Inferno

evidence.text: Can two axions support high-scale, chaotic-like inflation with a superplanckian trajectory inside a region of subplanckian diameter, while suppressing an η problem and easing control constraints in a string realization?

sources.title: Warping the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a single open-string axion in a warped compactification have a super-Planckian decay constant consistently with the Weak Gravity Conjecture, and can the resulting construction support large-field inflation with observable primordial tensors?

sources.title: Fencing in the Swampland: Quantum Gravity Constraints on Large Field Inflation

evidence.text: The paper asks whether collective axion mechanisms evade single-axion restrictions on large-field inflation. It seeks consistency tests useful when stabilization and corrections make explicit string constructions difficult to assess.

sources.title: Small field axion inflation with sub-Planckian decay constant

evidence.text: Can a previously proposed type IIB axion potential produce sufficient small-field inflation with a sub-Planckian decay constant, and what low inflation and reheating scales follow?

sources.title: Natural Inflation and Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can natural inflation with a parametrically large effective axion range be realized in a controlled higher-dimensional effective theory while satisfying the quantum-gravity constraints represented by the paper's Weak Gravity Conjecture criterion?

sources.title: Natural Inflation with Natural Trans-Planckian Axion Decay Constant from Anomalous $U(1)_X$

evidence.text: Can gauging an axion shift under anomalous U(1)X stabilize the real modulus independently of its axion, while generating a natural-inflation potential with an effective trans-Planckian decay constant?

sources.title: Super-Planckian axions from near-conformality

evidence.text: Can nearly conformal sectors generate exponentially hierarchical axion decay constants and trans-Planckian effective field ranges without tuned charges or many axion fields, with a calculable warped-space description?

sources.title: On the possibility of large axion decay constants

evidence.text: Can string/M-theory periodic fields have parametrically super-Planckian decay constants that provide sufficiently slow potential variation for natural inflation, or the much larger field ranges contemplated in anthropic cosmological-constant scenarios?

sources.title: Natural Inflation and Low Energy Supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can high-scale natural inflation coexist with low-scale or unbroken supersymmetry while addressing both effective trans-Planckian axion motion and stabilization of the saxionic partners in a string-inspired description?

sources.title: Catastrophic Inflation in the Axiverse

evidence.text: Can string-theory axions with sub-Planckian field ranges support slow-roll inflation through tuned mergers of critical points, without alignment, assuming saxions can be stabilized at the required cycle volumes?

sources.title: Natural Inflation from Near Alignment in Heterotic String Theory

evidence.text: Can near alignment of two heterotic Kähler axions generate a super-Planckian effective decay constant for natural inflation while their fundamental decay constants remain sub-Planckian?

sources.title: Constraints on Axion Inflation from the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can axion decay-constant alignment yield a controlled super-Planckian inflationary displacement in type-IIB Calabi–Yau compactifications, and what restrictions follow from divisor geometry and the generalized multi-axion weak gravity conjecture?
